theater: 廣南西路欽廉邕州與安南富良江

battle.name: 宋越熙寧戰爭
battle.theater: 廣南西路欽廉邕州與安南富良江
battle.brief: 熙寧八年，越將李常傑先發制人，水陸並進破欽廉，圍邕州四十餘日；宋神宗改遣郭逵、趙禼反攻，冬戰於富良江，越軍四百餘艘戰船橫江拒渡，宋軍伐木造發石機、乘大筏強攻奪船。卡面的希臘火不在這個戰場，但同期水戰的燃燒手段——火船與猛火油櫃——正是江面上真正點燃的東西。

kit.name: 希臘火
kit.history: 配在銅管裡的燃燒劑。配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。

countries: 交戰的兩大陣營，一方是北宋，另一方是越南李朝（大越），戰場橫跨廣南西路與安南本土。北宋方面由皇帝趙頊在汴京拍板，宰相王安石主持對交趾的戰略，前線設安南道行營，以馬步軍都總管兼本道經略招討司的名義統兵，配置正使、副使、副都總管，最初由趙禼與宦官李憲充正副使，兩人失和而改以郭逵為正使、趙禼為副，燕達任副都總管；地方上另有廣西都監張守節、提點刑獄宋球、歷任知桂州的沈起與劉彝。兵員以北方禁軍調撥與就地招募為主，出征又募集民夫搬運糧秣，嶺南峒丁與土丁則因熟悉山嶺小路而被倚重。宋廷同時遣使結交占城與真臘，請其出兵策應，占城答應遣蕃兵協助。李朝方面，七歲的仁宗李頊幼年即位，李常傑以檢校太尉兼領軍政，李道成以兵部侍郎輔政；李常傑自任統帥，宗亶分領一路大軍，麾下有象兵、步兵與一支數百艘戰船組成的江上水軍，廣源州等要地另設守將。
countriesEn: There were two principal camps in the field. On one side the Northern Song, on the other the Vietnamese Lý (Đại Việt), and the fighting stretched across Guangnan West Circuit and the Vietnamese interior. On the Song side the decision was taken by the emperor, Zhao Xu, at Bianjing, while the chancellor Wang Anshi directed the war policy towards Đại Việt. In the field an Army Headquarters for the Pacification of Annan was raised, a combined cavalry and infantry command also styled Superintendent and Pacification Commissioner for the Circuit, with a chief commissioner, a deputy and a second deputy commander. At first Zhao Bian and the eunuch Li Xian held the two senior posts, but the two fell out and the command was reorganised with Guo Kui as chief commissioner, Zhao Bian as his deputy and Yan Da as second deputy. Regional officials were involved too, among them the Guangxi Commander-in-Chief Zhang Shoujie, the Commissioner of Judicial Review Song Qiu, and Shen Qi and Liu Yi, who successively governed Guizhou prefecture, the modern Guilin. Troops came both from the northern imperial guards and from local recruitment, and a great many corvée labourers were conscripted to move grain; the Dong and native militia of the Lingnan were relied upon because they knew the mountain paths better than any soldier from the north. The court also sent envoys to Champa and Zhenla to ask them to strike in support, and Champa answered that it would send tribal troops. On the Lý side the seven-year-old Lý Nhân Tông, Lý Ứ, had come to the throne as a child, and Li Changjie, with the title of Assistant Grand Commandant, directed the government and the army with Li Đạo Thàng, Vice Minister of War, as his colleague. Li Changjie was general-in-chief and Nùng Tôn Đản led a second column, with an elephant corps, infantry, and a river flotilla of several hundred war-junks beneath them; strategic places such as Quảng Uyên were held by their own separate commanders.
people: 宋方最關鍵的推手是神宗趙頊與宰相王安石。趙頊在熙寧八年十二月發下討交趾敕諭，同意設行營發兵；王安石則把安南視為可以一舉而下的目標，先後向皇帝陳述越軍主力已空、機不可失，又主張藉一舉滅交趾的聲威去震懾西夏。地方上，知桂州沈起是造端者，他聲稱奉有密旨討交，按保甲法點集土丁、授以陣圖、歲時肄習；繼任的劉彝更進一步，斷絕交趾表章、禁止境內與交趾的貿易、命令使者在海濱集舟師寓教水戰，把桂州變成前沿。邕州知州蘇緄是死守者，孤城四十二日，最後與家屬三十六人自焚殉城。援軍方面，廣西都監張守節逗留觀望、迂道駐兵，遭越軍在崑崙關截擊，全軍覆沒而本人戰死；提點刑獄宋球以便宜督戰，逼他進兵，反而害了他。行營主將換成郭逵後，他主張冒險深入；趙禼為副，燕達領一路，設計誘敵渡江，最後破廣源州、降守將劉應紀，越方陣中還有漢人降將申景福的名字見於記載。李朝方面，統帥李常傑是這場戰爭的靈魂，出征前已有成算，敗後亦以詩自勵；宗亶分兵一路；輔政的李道成與宗室洪真太子、昭文王子在戰中陣亡，左郎將阮根被俘。
peopleEn: The decisive promoters on the Song side were the emperor, Shenzong, Zhao Xu, and the chancellor Wang Anshi. In the twelfth month of the Xining eighth year Zhao Xu issued the edict to punish Đại Việt and agreed to raise the headquarters and the army. Wang Anshi treated Annan as a prize that could be taken in one stroke; he told the emperor in turn that the Vietnamese main force had already left the country and that the opportunity was slipping away, and he argued that the prestige of wiping out Đại Việt in one blow could be turned against Western Xia. In the provinces, Shen Qi, governor of Guizhou prefecture, was the man who started the affair: he claimed to have received secret instructions to prepare an attack on Đại Việt, and he mustered the native militia under the baojia system, handed out drill formations and had them practised at fixed seasons. His successor Liu Yi went further, cutting off Đại Việt's memorials, forbidding trade between the border districts and Đại Việt, and ordering his envoys to assemble war-junks on the coast and drill the crews in water fighting, turning Guizhou into a forward base. Su Xian, the prefect of Yinzhou, was the man who held out: isolated for forty-two days, he finally burned himself to death with thirty-six members of his household. On the relief column, the Guangxi Commander-in-Chief Zhang Shoujie hung back, waited to see how the fighting went and took a roundabout route; he was intercepted at Kunlun Pass, his whole force was destroyed and he was killed. Song Qiu, the Commissioner of Judicial Review, pressed him forward on his own authority and that only hastened the disaster. When Guo Kui took over as chief commissioner he argued for driving deep into the country. Zhao Bian was his deputy and Yan Da led one of the columns, laying an ambush that drew the enemy across the river; in the end he took Quảng Uyên and received the surrender of its commandant Liu Yingji. The name of a Chinese defector, Shen Jingfu, is also found among the Lý staff. On the Lý side the soul of the war was Li Changjie, the general-in-chief, who had already reckoned up the campaign before the army marched and who met defeat with a poem to steady his own troops. Nùng Tôn Đản led a second column. Li Đạo Thàng, the minister who assisted the government, and members of the royal house, the Crown Prince Hồng Chân and the Prince Chiêu Văn, were killed in the fighting, and the Left Captain Nguyễn Căn was taken prisoner.
kits: 卡面上的希臘火並不曾在這個戰場出現，這一點要說清楚：它是七世紀拜占庭帝國的國家機密，裝在銅管之中，由船上的操作手以人力泵把難以熄滅的燃燒劑壓出水面，配方與器具由帝國中樞獨佔而不外傳，紀錄始於七世紀末對阿拉伯海軍的攻擊，到十二世紀初已近乎絕跡。東亞同時存在的是另一套燃燒技術：宋代《武經總要》所載的猛火油櫃一類器械，用管盛油膏，可噴向城樓與船隻，另有水戰所用的火船，以載有易燃油料與引火物的快船撞入敵陣；原理同屬把燃燒物壓向目標，但並無專門的燃燒兵種，也沒有帝國級的保密。交趾方面本役用得最多的不是火，而是象與弩：越軍列象陣阻道，宋軍以強弩猛射、再用長刀砍象鼻，使受驚之象回奔而衝亂本方隊形。攻城器械方面，越軍依歸附之眾善攻城之長，堆積土囊登城；宋軍則伐木趕造發石機，遠擊江上船隻，並以大筏載精兵強渡。遠程火力與輕兵器有弩、弓箭、長刀，糧秣靠船隊沿海路運抵廣西前線，而瘴癘之地本身，就是宋軍最難對付的敵人。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card was never present on this battlefield, and that has to be said first. Greek fire was a state secret of the seventh-century Byzantine Empire: it was carried in bronze tubes and forced out onto the water by an operator working a hand pump aboard the ship, the formula and the apparatus being held by the imperial centre and never given out. The earliest records date from the attacks on Arab fleets at the end of the seventh century, and by the early twelfth century it had very nearly vanished. What existed in East Asia at the same time was a different body of incendiary technique: the menghuoyougui, a container of oil or grease with a tube, described in the Song military manual Wujing Zongyao, capable of spraying burning liquid at towers and ships, and the fire ships used in river warfare, fast boats loaded with combustible material and kindling that were rowed into the enemy's line. The principle is the same in both cases — driving a burning substance towards the target — but there was no dedicated corps of flame-throwers and no imperial monopoly of the secret. What the Lý army actually relied on in this campaign was not fire but elephants and crossbows: they formed up elephants to bar the road, and the Song answered with heavy crossbows and then with long sabres against the animals' trunks, so that the panic-stricken elephants turned back and broke their own lines. For siege work the Vietnamese used the surrendered men who knew how to storm walls, piling up sacks of earth to climb the ramparts; the Song felled timber and hurried up stone-throwers to strike the boats on the river, then loaded elite troops onto large rafts and forced the crossing. Long-range fire and light arms included crossbows, bows and long sabres; grain and stores were moved by water along the coast to the forward depots in Guangxi; and the miasma of the southern swamps was itself an enemy the Song army found harder to fight than any general.
tactics: 整場戰爭的戰術可以分成三段。李朝先發制人，水陸並進：李常傑與宗亶分兩路，陸路沿廣西海岸推進，連下欽州、廉州，水路沿欽州海道北上直趨邕州；越軍一路張榜以示師出有名，作法是先打援軍、再圍孤城，張守節的援軍在崑崙關被截滅，邕州遂成孤城；破城則靠歸附之眾堆積土囊登城，四十二日而克。宋軍反擊的戰術重點有三：一是示弱誘敵，燕達建議在山間設伏、逐步減兵，使李常傑傾數萬眾渡江出擊，伏兵盡發，步騎合擊，趁其帆折檣摧之際選精兵乘大筏猛攻；二是對付越軍四百餘艘戰船橫江阻路，伐木製造發石機遠擊，再以大筏強渡；三是分進合擊與追擊，趙禼與郭逵分兵追取欽廉，燕達一路北進，先拔機榔、門州，再取廣源州，宋軍並利用占城蕃兵七千扼交趾要路，試圖斷其外援。整體而言，這是一場以水陸配合、攻城技術與熱帶瘴癘消耗互搏的戰役，水上機動能力與糧秣運輸決定了宋軍的極限。
tacticsEn: The campaign can be divided into three tactical phases. The Lý struck first, by land and by sea: Li Changjie and Nùng Tôn Đản split their force in two, the land column pushing along the coast of Guangxi and taking Qinzhou and Lianzhou in turn, while the sea column worked up the maritime route from Qinzhou to strike at Yinzhou. The Vietnamese posted proclamations the whole way to make their cause look just, and their method was to destroy the relief column first and then invest the isolated city; the relief force under Zhang Shoujie was cut up at Kunlun Pass, which left Yinzhou alone, and the city was then taken by men who had surrendered and knew how to storm walls, climbing the ramparts on piles of earth sacks until it fell on the forty-second day. The Song counter-offensive rested on three tactical ideas. First, to make the enemy overcommit: Yan Da advised laying an ambush among the hills and thinning the ranks step by step, so that Li Changjie would commit tens of thousands to crossing the river; the ambush then closed, infantry and cavalry struck together, and, at the moment the enemy's sails and masts were broken, picked troops were put onto large rafts and hit hard. Second, to answer the four hundred odd war-junks that stood across the river blocking the water: timber was cut and stone-throwers built at once to strike them at range, after which the rafts forced the crossing. Third, to advance in separate columns and pursue: Zhao Bian and Guo Kui split to recover Qinzhou and Lianzhou, while Yan Da drove north, taking Korang and Men prefecture and then Quảng Uyên, and the Song brought in seven thousand Cham troops to hold the key routes into Đại Việt and cut the enemy from outside help. Taken as a whole this was a campaign fought between combined land-and-sea manoeuvre, siege technique and the attrition of tropical disease, and the limits of the Song army were set by its capacity on the water and by its supply lines.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。時間線：熙寧八年（1075）十一月李常傑、宗亶分兵出擊，同月三十日破欽州，十二月初一日破廉州；熙寧九年（1076）正月至二月圍邕州，三月初一城破，圍城凡四十二日；同年十月燕達破廣源州、降守將劉應紀，取機榔縣與門州；十二月二十一日宋軍抵富良江與越軍決戰；熙寧十年（1077）春宋李講和，宋軍撤回，李朝奉表納貢。兵力：邕州宋軍原有正規軍二千八百餘，募兵後勉強增至四千餘人；宋軍反擊時宣稱十萬正規軍、二十萬民夫，另有占城蕃兵七千；廣西境內越軍據《宋史紀事本末》為八萬、《越史略》為十萬，李朝境內兵員推定六萬。損失：張守節所部三千兵全軍覆沒，蘇緄與家屬自焚殉城；如月江初戰宋軍折損千餘人；富良江之戰宋軍殺傷越軍數千，洪真太子、昭文王子陣亡，阮根被俘。宋軍自身折損，《長編》記死者二十萬，《玉海》記「兵夫三十萬人冒暑涉瘴地，死者過半」，《太平治迹統類》記「瘴毒日甚，眾死亡十九」，同類記載數量互有出入，宜取「折損慘重、瘴癘為主因」的量級，而不逐條坐實。戰果：宋軍收復欽廉、取廣源州與機榔、門州，越軍前期則連下欽廉邕三州。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The timeline: in the eleventh month of the Xining eighth year, 1075, Li Changjie and Nùng Tôn Đản marched out in two columns; they took Qinzhou on the thirtieth of the same month and Lianzhou on the first day of the twelfth. In the first and second months of the ninth year, 1076, they invested Yinzhou, which fell on the first day of the third month after a siege of forty-two days. In the tenth month of that year Yan Da took Quảng Uyên and received the surrender of its commandant Liu Yingji, and took the counties of Korang and Men; on the twenty-first day of the twelfth month the Song army reached the Red River and fought the decisive battle. In the spring of the tenth year of Xining, 1077, the Song and the Lý made peace, the Song withdrew and the Lý sent a memorial with tribute. Strength: Yinzhou held a little over 2,800 regular soldiers, raised to rather more than 4,000 with recruits; the Song counter-offensive was announced at 100,000 regular soldiers and 200,000 labourers, with a further 7,000 Champa troops; the Vietnamese force inside Guangxi is given as 80,000 in the Songshi Jishi Benmo and 100,000 in the Yuèshǐlüè, and the troops inside Đại Việt are put at 60,000 by inference. Losses: the three thousand men under Zhang Shoujie were destroyed to a man, and Su Xian burned himself to death with his household; the first clash at the Ruoyue crossing cost the Song over a thousand men; at the Red River the Song killed several thousand of the Vietnamese, the Crown Prince Hồng Chân and the Prince Chiêu Văn were killed, and Nguyễn Căn was taken prisoner. On the Song side, the Zengbuan Tongzhi records 200,000 dead, the Yuhai records that of 300,000 soldiers and labourers who marched through the miasma in the heat more than half perished, and the Taiping Zhizhi Tonglei records that the poisonous miasma grew worse and that nineteen in ten of the host died. These figures vary, so the safe reading is heavy loss with disease as the main cause, rather than any single number taken literally. Gains: the Song recovered Qinzhou and Lianzhou and took Quảng Uyên, Korang and Men; in the earlier phase the Vietnamese had taken Qinzhou, Lianzhou and Yinzhou in turn.
cause: 打起來的原因有遠有近。近因出在廣西的地方官：熙寧六年沈起出任知桂州，聲稱奉有朝廷密旨準備討伐交趾，按保甲法點集土丁、授以陣圖、歲時肄習，諸峒騷然；繼任的劉彝比前人更進一層，斷絕交趾的表章往來、禁止境內鹽米與交趾的貿易、命令使者在海濱集舟師教水戰。兩人的行為都被越方解讀為宋朝即將大舉滅國的消息，李朝君臣因此不安，據《涑水記聞》，嶺南進士徐百祥把宋廷的攻越計劃洩露給交趾，並獻策「先人有奪人之心，不若先舉兵入寇」，越方遂下定先發制人的決心。遠因則是體制性的：自黎桓篡丁之後，李朝前黎與李朝表面上向宋納貢稱臣，實則不斷蠶食宋境，1014年欽州曾包庇越南逃犯，李公蘊引兵犯境；宋廷則因北方有遼與西夏，長期對交趾容忍姑息，這種一退一進的關係維持了近百年。更深一層是宋廷對交趾的輕蔑與野心：宋人視交州為小邦，一旦有機會便想一舉而有之，王安石甚至計劃用交趾的聲威去震懾西夏；而李朝剛經過仁宗幼年即位，朝中尚有李常傑、李道成這般能打的權臣，正是敢於冒險的時機。
causeEn: The reasons for the fighting were both immediate and remote. The proximate cause lay with the provincial officials in Guangxi. In the sixth year of Xining, Shen Qi took up the governorship of Guizhou prefecture and announced that he had secret instructions to prepare an attack on Đại Việt; he mustered the native militia under the baojia system, issued drill formations and had them practised at fixed seasons, and the mountain districts were stirred. His successor Liu Yi went further, cutting off Đại Việt's memorials, forbidding the salt and rice trade between the border districts and Đại Việt, and ordering his envoys to assemble war-junks on the coast and drill the crews in water fighting. The Lý court read all of this as news that the Song was about to destroy the country outright, and the panic in Đại Việt grew. According to the Suishui Jiwen, a candidate from Lingnan named Xu Baixiang leaked the Song plan for the attack to the Lý court and offered the counsel that it is better to seize the other side's heart first and that it would be wiser to strike into the enemy before being struck; the Vietnamese accordingly resolved to get the first blow. The remote cause was structural. Since Lê Hoàn had seized the throne, the former Lê and the Lý dynasties had outwardly made submission and paid tribute to the Song while steadily eating into Song territory; in 1014 Qinzhou sheltered Vietnamese fugitives and Lê Công Viễn led troops across the border. The Song court, preoccupied with the Liao and Western Xia in the north, had long been content to tolerate Đại Việt, and this give-and-take lasted for the best part of a century. Beneath it lay the Song court's contempt and its appetite: the Chinese regarded the province of Jiuzhou as a minor state to be taken at the first opportunity, and Wang Anshi even hoped to use the prestige of conquering Đại Việt to overawe Western Xia. The Lý, meanwhile, had just seen a child emperor ascend the throne under regents such as Li Changjie and Li Đạo Thàng, men who could actually fight, and that was precisely the moment to dare.
impact: 這場戰爭留下的東西，比戰果本身更深。第一，它把宋朝的新法與新將大臣的邊功政策推到一個難堪的位置：沈起、劉彝被罷，御史追究「妄傳密受朝廷意旨」，史家直言「安南之師，死者二十萬，朝廷當任其咎」，蘇軾更指王安石用事以來「始求邊功」，結怨安南；安南之役從此成為反對派攻擊新法最有力的把柄之一。第二，它扭轉了宋廷對西南的政策方向：此後放棄攻取交趾的打算，轉而以廣西為防守之區，安南道行營裁撤，欽、廉、邕一線的屯戍與寨柵重新佈局，與李朝之間回到以互市為主、朝貢為輔的關係。第三，它也證明李朝並非只能挨打：越南在幼主之下仍能集中數萬大軍遠征深入、攻破宋軍重鎮，說明李氏的軍政組織在仁宗初年已相當成熟。第四，在外交上，此役開了宋廷拉攏第三方的先例：張方平建議遣使占城、真臘求援，占城答應出兵七千扼交趾要路，這種以南海小國制衡交趾的思路，此後在宋越關係中反覆被提起。第五，在軍事技術上，這是一場投射器械與水戰交匯的戰役：宋軍伐木造發石機、以強弩射象、以大筏強渡，越軍以數百艘戰船與象陣應戰，人力投射的燃燒與投擲器械第一次在宋越邊境上大規模較量。
impactEn: What this war left behind reached deeper than its immediate results. First, it drove the Song's new policies and the frontier ambitions of its new military and civil officials into an awkward corner. Shen Qi and Liu Yi were dismissed, the censors pressed them for having passed on supposed secret instructions, the historians said plainly that of the army that went to Annan two hundred thousand were dead and that the court must answer for it, and Su Shi charged that since Wang Anshi had taken power he had sought military credit at the frontier and had made an enemy of Annan. The Annan campaign became from then on one of the strongest handles the opposition had against the new laws. Second, it reversed the court's policy in the southwest: the intention to seize Đại Việt was abandoned, Guangxi became a defensive region, the Annan headquarters was wound up, the garrisons and stockades along the Qinzhou, Lianzhou and Yinzhou line were re-laid out, and relations with the Lý settled back into mutual trade first and tribute second. Third, it showed that the Lý were not a people who could only take blows: a Vietnam under a child king could still concentrate tens of thousands and carry them deep into Song territory and capture a major Song city, which shows that the organisation of the Lý state had already become quite mature in the first years of Nhân Tông. Fourth, in diplomatic terms the campaign opened the precedent of the Song court playing third parties: at Zhang Fangping's proposal envoys were sent to Champa and Zhenla to ask for help, and Champa answered that it would send seven thousand men to hold the key routes into Đại Việt, and this idea of balancing Đại Việt with the small states of the South Sea was raised again and again in later Song–Lý relations. Fifth, in military technology this was a campaign where projection devices and river warfare met: the Song built stone-throwers from felled timber, shot elephants with heavy crossbows and forced crossings on great rafts, while the Vietnamese answered with several hundred war-junks and lines of elephants, and human-powered incendiaries and missile engines were tried out on a large scale for the first time along the Song–Lý frontier.
result: 結果是一場雙方都自認勝利的和局。熙寧十年（1077）春，李仁宗奉表求和，宋廷同意撤兵，郭逵以「願以一身活十餘萬人命」自請退兵，兩國恢復朝貢：宋軍退出交趾，越軍退出欽、廉、邕，李朝向宋納貢，形式上恢復了以中國為宗主國的朝貢體系。戰場上則是宋軍的攻勢在瘴癘與糧秣面前止步：宋軍收復欽廉、攻入安南、取廣源州與機榔、門州之後，再無力深入；而李朝雖然光復失地，國力亦因遠征與疫病而重創，仁宗朝此後二十餘年再未大舉北進。對宋廷而言，這是一場典型的得不償失的遠征：十餘萬人馬的出動、數十萬民夫的轉運，最後只換來一座被攻破的邕州和一次滿載詬病的撤兵，安南道行營裁撤，涉事官員相繼貶黜。對李朝而言，這一役則是幼年朝廷的立國之戰：李常傑的先發制人贏得軍事上的主動，雖不能阻止宋軍還擊，卻在宋廷心裡留下交趾不可輕看的印象，也讓李仁宗的統治在開國之後站穩了腳跟。
resultEn: The result was a negotiated peace in which each side claimed to have won. In the spring of the tenth year of Xining, 1077, Lý Nhân Tông sent a memorial asking for peace, the court agreed to withdraw, and Guo Kui volunteered to leave the army with the words that he would give his own life to save the lives of more than a hundred thousand men. Tribute was resumed: the Song army left Đại Việt, the Vietnamese army withdrew from Qinzhou, Lianzhou and Yinzhou, and the Lý paid tribute to the Song, formally restoring the tribute system with China as the overlord. On the ground, however, the Song advance was checked by disease and by supply: after recovering Qinzhou and Lianzhou, entering Đại Việt and taking Quảng Uyên, Korang and Men, the Song had no strength left to go deeper. The Lý recovered their lost territory, but the country was also worn down by the expedition and by disease, and for more than twenty years under Nhân Tông it did not launch another great northern campaign. For the Song court this was a classic expedition that cost more than it brought: the movement of a hundred thousand men and the transport of several hundred thousand labourers bought only a captured Yinzhou and a withdrawal loaded with recrimination, the Annan headquarters was wound up and the officials involved were demoted one after another. For the Lý the campaign was the making of a state still governed by a child: Li Changjie's decision to strike first won the initiative in the field; it could not prevent the Song counterstroke, but it left the Song court with the impression that Đại Việt was not to be treated lightly, and it gave the rule of Lý Nhân Tông a secure footing in the years after the founding of the dynasty.
